name: Lunacid

material_overrides.reason: Cutout stain puddle quad rendered as opaque black polygon due to _Clip: 0 on texture with 68.4% transparent alpha. Requires _Clip: 1 and _CLIP_ON keyword.

shader_overrides.reason: Original shader had only ForwardBase pass, causing 21 point/spot lights in MainMenu to be completely ignored (walls rendered pitch black). Added ForwardAdd pass with Blend One One and UNITY_LIGHT_ATTENUATION.
Fullscreen camera post-process blit shader for Effect_scr.cs (fade-in/out and gamma). Generic stub transformed quad into 3D clip-space with ZWrite On, causing solid purple occlusion of the menu.
Decompiled moon stub rendered as black sphere or unlit magenta. Replaced with unlit additive/transparent SubShader with emission.

ui_and_camera.flash_fade_effect: FLASH_FADE (Flash_scr.cs - white screen UI canvas transition)

quirks: Android file I/O: Application.dataPath points to read-only package directory; requires redirection to persistentDataPath for saves and settings.
Legacy precompiled DLLs: Unity.TextMeshPro, Unity.InputSystem, UnityEngine.UI in Assets/Plugins must be removed and GUIDs remapped.
Built-in shader stripping: Unity 6 strips unreferenced built-in shaders on Android; requires preloading 72+ shaders in m_AlwaysIncludedShaders.
Post-processing blit failure: PostProcessLayer and RetroLookPro blit pass 4 crashes Vulkan/Quest; disabled dynamically via IProcessSceneWithReport.
